description: An application submitted under Section 73 of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a minor material amendment in connection with the planning permission (DC/23/130258) dated 20 February 2024 for the Mixed-use redevelopment of the site for a new building comprising part 10, part 26 storeys, including purpose built student accommodation and associated amenity space (Sui Generis), affordable residential (use class C3), light industrial use at ground and first floor levels (Use Class E(g)), and retail / community use (Use Class E(a) / F1 / F2) at ground floor level, together with associated landscaping, ancillary plant, servicing and associated enabling work at Apollo Business Centre, 158 Trundley's Road SE8, in order to:- add a new planning condition to allow phasing of development;- amend Condition (2);- amend Planning Informative C.
site_name: APOLLO BUSINESS CENTRE, 158 TRUNDLEY'S ROAD, LONDON, SE8 5JE
